missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вокзал' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Этот' agrees in masculine gender, and 'старый' is the agreeing adjective. A simple descriptive model.

missions.phrase: Мы приехали на вокзал рано утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'Вокзал' takes the accusative after 'на' to express arrival at a place. 'Рано утром' sets the time. The standard pattern for going to a station.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a preposition. 'Вокзала' takes the genitive after 'возле' to mean near the station. A natural way to arrange a meeting point.

missions.phrase: На вокзале было очень много людей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Вокзале' uses the prepositional form after 'на' to describe where something happened. 'Много людей' adds the crowd. Useful for describing a scene.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Вокзалу' takes the dative after 'к' to express movement toward the station. A clean pattern for giving directions.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'Вокзалом' takes the instrumental after 'перед' to show position in front. 'Большая площадь' is the nominative subject. Good for spatial description.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Вокзала' takes the genitive singular after 'два'. This counting pattern is essential and applies to all masculine nouns with two, three, or four.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вокзалы' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'огромные' is the agreeing plural adjective. Useful for general statements.

missions.phrase: Мы уехали с вокзала поздно вечером.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of departure. 'Вокзала' takes the genitive after 'с' to express leaving a place. 'Поздно вечером' sets the time. The mirror of arriving.

missions.phrase: Я плохо помню этот старый вокзал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вокзал' is the inanimate masculine accusative direct object of 'помню', identical to its nominative form. 'Этот старый' agrees in the accusative. Good for memory talk.
